title: World Chess Championship: Gukesh aur Sindarov ke beech Game 3 bhi draw
summary: Geneva mein chal rahe World Chess Championship ka teesra game bhi 60 moves ke baad draw par khatam hua. Score ab 1.5-1.5 par barabar hai.
key_points: D. Gukesh aur Javokhir Sindarov ke beech Game 3 kareeb paanch ghante chala
Black pieces ke sath khelte hue Gukesh ne lamba pressure banaye rakha
Sindarov ne time pressure ke bawajood 40th move par bachao kiya
Tino games draw hone ke baad ab score 1.5-1.5 ki barabari par hai
body: World Chess Championship ka teesra muqabla kafi lamba aur romanchak raha. Geneva mein khele gaye is match mein D. Gukesh aur Javokhir Sindarov ke beech kareeb paanch ghante tak takkar chali, jo is series ka sabse lamba game raha.

Black pieces ke sath khelne ke bawajood Gukesh ne shuruat mein zabardast tayari dikhayi. Unhone apne pehle 15 moves sirf 132 seconds mein pure kar liye, jisse Uzbek challenger Sindarov par clock ka dabav badh gaya.
Game mein ek samay aisi sthiti aayi jab Sindarov ke paas 39th move chalne ke liye sirf 8 seconds bache the. Lekin unhone samay rehte sahi move chal kar is khatre ko taal diya aur sthiti ko sambhala.

Aakhirkar rooks exchange hone ke baad opposite-coloured bishops bache aur 60 moves ke baad dono khiladiyon ne king repetition se draw par sahamati jata di. Ab yeh muqabla 1.5-1.5 ki barabari par hai aur khiladi ek din ke rest ke baad agla game khelenge.
why_it_matters: Lagaatar teesra draw hone se yeh World Championship kafi romanchak ho gaya hai. Dono khiladiyon ki kadi takkar yeh dikhati hai ki title ke liye kitna sangharsh chal raha hai.
